title: The Average family in the street
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：average　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 average 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the fisherman wrote of ① an average family in the street in the logbook, and everybody in the harbour said at once that it was ② more average than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the fisherman, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the average ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most average family in the street anybody in the harbour had ever seen, or so the logbook for July 1945 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too average to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the boatman who had come to help; the average ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an average score for the class, and said that no boatman in his right mind would call it ⑥ as average as the score for the class they had once had in the old harbour. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was average or not, and he said so.

By 1958 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something average, and nothing besides. The boatman from the next harbour called the whole plan ⑧ quite average; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the logbook kept the names of the average ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1961, in silence, she wrote of another average family in the street in the same logbook, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more average than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most average score for the class in the whole harbour, she said in 1963, was the one she could never quite name; the average ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 普通（前置定语 an average family in the street：1951 年渔人在航海日志里记下的那件普通的家庭）
B. adj. 普通／平均（比较级 more average than：文中两处，一处比街上的家庭，一处比预想）
C. adj. 普通／平均（最高级 the most average：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 普通（表语 too average to do：母亲觉得它太普通，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 平均（前置定语 an average score for the class：叔叔把整件事称作一桩平均的均分）
F. adj. 平均（同级比较 as average as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩全班的均分相比）
G. adj. 平均（后置定语 something average：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 平均（受程度副词修饰 quite average：那位船工的评价）

items.q: an average family in the street
the most average family in the street anybody
an average score for the class
The most average score for the class in

answers.why: average 意为“普通”，1951 年渔人在航海日志里记下的是“一件普通的家庭”，此处作前置定语 an average family in the street。
average 意为“普通”，此处用比较级 more average than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
average 意为“普通”，航海日志上 七月 那行字说它是渔港里最普通的一件，故用最高级 the most average family in the street。
average 意为“普通”，母亲认为这件东西“太普通了，谁也用不上”，too average to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
average 意为“平均”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩平均的均分”，此处作前置定语 an average score for the class。
average 意为“平均”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩全班的均分一样平均”，同级比较用 as average as。
average 意为“平均”，航海日志上那半行字要的是“平均的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something average。
average 意为“平均”，邻渔港来的那位船工认为这套计划“相当平均”，quite 修饰原级 average。
average 意为“平均”，1961 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要平均”，故用比较级 more average than。
average 意为“平均”，母亲 1963 年说的是“整个渔港里最平均的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most average score for the class。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，渔人在航海日志里记下了一件普通的家庭。（an average family in the street）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更普通。（more average than …）
母亲觉得它太普通，谁也用不上。（too average to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩平均的均分。（an average score for the class）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩全班的均分一样平均。（as average as …）
到了 1958 年，航海日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件平均的东西。（something average）
answers: In 1951 the fisherman wrote of an average family in the street in the logbook.
Everybody said it was more average than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too average to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an average score for the class.
He said nobody would call it as average as the score for the class they had once had.
By 1958 the logbook asked for nothing but something average.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 average 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the fisherman wrote of an average family in the street in the logbook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most average family in the street in the harbour, or so the logbook says.
My mother thought it too average to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an average score for the class, and nobody argued with him.
The boatman from the next harbour called the plan quite average, and everybody laughed.
The average ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
